MERN Q&A.q: How does the MERN stack communicate?
MERN Q&A.a: React frontend sends fetch requests with HTTP headers to the Express API server, which queries MongoDB via Mongoose and returns JSON arrays.

MERN Q&A.q: How do you protect routes in MERN?
MERN Q&A.a: Use a JWT token stored in an HTTP-Only Cookie. Express route middleware verifies the token signature, and React Router redirects unauthenticated views.
